description: Create a secure Stripe checkout link on arcticsci.com for items with published prices. The buyer opens the link to review the order, see sales tax and pay; nothing is charged until they do. Use the shipping option id from get_shipping_estimate, or leave it out for the lowest rate. Items priced on request, custom made (quote_only) products, or orders over the payment limits need request_quote instead.

address.description: Shipping address. state is required only in the US and Canada (2-letter code); elsewhere it is optional. zip is required except in countries without postal codes.

company.description: Company or institution. Required: Arctic White ships to businesses and labs.

country.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. US, DE, GB

state.description: 2-letter state or province code in the US and Canada (e.g. PA, ON); region name or blank elsewhere

email.description: Buyer's email, prefilled on the payment page (optional)

items.description: Products and quantities. Quantity is in the product's selling unit (usually cases).

shipping_rate_id.description: id from get_shipping_estimate (optional; the lowest rate is used when left out)

name: start_checkout

checkout_url.description: Stripe payment page on arcticsci.com's account. Give it to the buyer; it expires in 24 hours.

shipping_service.description: Carrier and service, e.g. FedEx Ground

title: Start checkout
